# apipbx_trunk (Resource)

A trunk to a carrier (SIP or IAX2). Import with "<tenant id>/<trunk id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String)
- `name` (String) Starts with a letter; a-z 0-9 _ -.
- `tech` (String) pjsip or iax2.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `continue_on_fail` (Boolean) Try the next trunk after any failure.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `inbound_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret for inbound_username (8-64 characters).
- `inbound_username` (String) IAX2 only: the user name the carrier presents when it calls you (empty: it is recognised as the trunk's own peer, asterisk_id). Unique across the whole server.
- `max_channels` (Number) 0 = unlimited.
- `outbound_cid` (String)
- `port` (Number) Provider port; the technology's default when omitted. Cannot be cleared once set.
- `register` (Boolean) Register to the provider (pjsip only; needs username).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `asterisk_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
